Bella monet metuenda malis, atque aggerat iras.

Sorte ferét. Sed enim iustos pia cura fanórque

pages.notes: The first stanza's line 2 reads "Nil (inquam) nihil ista moror." with "rector" set with a ct ligature; transcribed as rector. "familla" and "fanórque" are copied as printed. The subscription "N. C. A. D." is set right-aligned and treated as a paragraph. The large initial V of "VENERE" is joined to the word. The gathering signature "Q. iij." is at the lower right. Some faint show-through from the reverse page is visible in the right half and was left out.

Stanza breaks follow the four-line pattern of the printed verse. Line 6, "cælifassa[?]", is doubtful: the word is set in a long-s ligature and I could not read it with certainty. Line 28, "lenamen[?]", appears to read so in print; it may be a printing error for "levamen", left as printed. Line 3 "acerui" and line 23 "vasis" are read from the long-s forms and are otherwise clear. The faint text on the right is show-through from the reverse and is omitted.
